mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals persistent monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal weak consumer demand, reducing corporate revenues and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 90.0 indicates supply chain disruption, reducing corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) declining more than 2.0% signals weakening residential demand, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST decline > 2.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase and payroll employment decline indicate severe labor market contraction, reducing household income and consumption, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 400,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 400000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
